zh-CN.name: SAG Wiki 技能
zh-CN.shortDesc: SAG CLI 技能，用于安装配置、语义检索、索引目录、忽略规则和 MCP。需另行安装并运行独立许可的 @zleap-ai/sag CLI；本条目只指向 cli/skills/sag，不含完整 SAG Wiki 应用。准入暂停为仅收录：现行 DesireCore 安装器只复制该路径，不会把仓库根目录的 MIT LICENSE 附进安装产物。

en-US.name: SAG Wiki Skill
en-US.shortDesc: SAG CLI skill for setup, semantic search, indexed folders, ignore rules and MCP configuration. Install and run the separately licensed @zleap-ai/sag CLI; this entry points at cli/skills/sag only, not the full SAG Wiki app. Admission is paused at listing-only: the current DesireCore installer copies only that path and does not attach the repository-root MIT LICENSE.
